title: PVST+ Configuration
description: Configure per-VLAN Spanning Tree and a custom root bridge for posting network.
scenario: Configure per-VLAN Spanning Tree and a custom root bridge for posting network.

concepts.title: What is PVST+?
concepts.body: PVST+ (Per-VLAN Spanning Tree) runs one Spanning Tree instance per VLAN. It is compatible with classic STP and RSTP.
concepts.code:
VLAN 1 → one ST tree
VLAN 10 → one ST tree
Each VLAN independent root

concepts.title: Root per VLAN
concepts.body: Each VLAN can have a different root bridge. Example: SW1 is root for VLAN 10, SW2 root for VLAN 20 to balance duplex summary traffic.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# spanning-tree vlan 10 root primary
SW1(config)# spanning-tree vlan 20 priority 8192

concepts.title: Troubleshooting
concepts.body: "show spanning-tree vlan <id>" shows the instance and block ports for that VLAN only.
concepts.code:
SW1# showing spanning-tree vlan 10
VLAN00010: ST is root
 Bridge ID: 32768 (primary 4096, sys-ext 10)
